quarterly_data.quarter: Lenovo HKEX announcement: FY2026/27 First Quarter Results Announcement (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026/27 detail beyond the call (results announcement): gross profit margin 16.5%, up 1.8 points, primarily on improved ISG profitability; capital expenditure US$374 million (US$468 million a year earlier); inventories rose to US$15,741,947 thousand at June 30, 2026 from US$11,720,885 thousand at March 31, 2026 (raw materials and work-in-progress US$9,961,612 thousand); bank deposits and cash US$6,081 million. The company says component supply-demand imbalances may continue to create near-term headwinds and market volatility.
quarterly_data.figure: gross margin 16.5% (+1.8 pts); inventories US$15,741,947 thousand; Q1 capex US$374 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Lenovo HKEX announcement: FY2026/27 First Quarter Results Announcement (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Acquisitions completed (results announcement): on April 9, 2026 Lenovo completed the acquisition of the entire interests in Infinidat (high-performance enterprise storage), which contributed US$55 million of revenue and US$2.1 million of profit before taxation in the quarter; on April 27, 2026 it completed the acquisition of the entire interests in Phoenix Technologies EMEA Limited (firmware for computers and computing devices).
quarterly_data.figure: Infinidat Q1 revenue contribution US$55 million
